cohort: Women with severe preeclampsia at ≤ 26+0 weeks of gestation
finding: Maternal complications during hospitalization were equivalent between expectant management and termination of pregnancy for severe preeclampsia before 26 weeks, but maternal reproductive future might have been compromised in 20% of cases due to a higher risk of uterine rupture in subsequent pregnancies for patients having classic cesarean (vertical incision).
mod_finding: The rate of cesarean section was 66.7% in the expectant management group, and 20% of patients had vertical incision.
